findings.title: HTTP response
findings.recommendation: Check the live response and fix unexpected HTTP errors.

findings.title: A descriptive page title
findings.detail: Observed title: RankSushi — Less SEO overwhelm. More found you.
findings.recommendation: Describe the page’s purpose in a specific title. Length is a preview consideration, not a ranking rule.

evidence.detail: Observed title: RankSushi — Less SEO overwhelm. More found you.

findings.title: A useful search description
findings.detail: 143 characters: Turn website audits and Search Console data into your next useful action. SEO, answer readiness, editable content, and progress — served fresh.
findings.recommendation: Write an accurate summary that gives people a reason to visit. Search engines may choose a different snippet.

evidence.detail: 143 characters: Turn website audits and Search Console data into your next useful action. SEO, answer readiness, editable content, and progress — served fresh.

findings.title: Clear page structure
findings.detail: 1 H1 headings and 28 H1–H3 headings were observed.
findings.recommendation: Give the page a clear main heading and organize sections logically. Multiple H1s are not automatically an SEO failure.

evidence.detail: 1 H1 headings and 28 H1–H3 headings were observed.

findings.title: Preferred page URL
findings.detail: Preferred URL: https://ranksushi.com/ (points to another URL; may be intentional)
findings.recommendation: Confirm the preferred URL before changing canonicals. An alternate canonical can be intentional.

evidence.detail: Preferred URL: https://ranksushi.com/ (points to another URL; may be intentional)

findings.title: Search indexing preference
findings.detail: No noindex directive was found in the available evidence. This does not confirm indexability or indexing.
findings.recommendation: Keep noindex for pages meant to be private or excluded. Only remove it when this page should appear in search.

evidence.detail: No noindex directive was found in the available evidence. This does not confirm indexability or indexing.

findings.title: Responsive viewport
findings.recommendation: Check the mobile layout and declare an appropriate viewport.

findings.title: Image alternatives
findings.detail: 0 of 0 images lack an alt attribute. Empty alt attributes are treated as decorative.
findings.recommendation: Describe meaningful images and use empty alt text for decorative images. Review image purpose before editing.

evidence.detail: 0 of 0 images lack an alt attribute. Empty alt attributes are treated as decorative.

findings.title: Readable structured data
findings.detail: 1 valid JSON-LD blocks; 0 malformed blocks. Syntax validation does not confirm rich-result eligibility or factual accuracy.
findings.recommendation: Use a relevant schema type only when it matches visible page content. Review required fields and test eligible markup.

evidence.detail: 1 valid JSON-LD blocks; 0 malformed blocks. Syntax validation does not confirm rich-result eligibility or factual accuracy.

findings.title: Structured data matches the page
findings.detail: 1 markup checks need review: This value was not matched in the supplied visible content. Confirm it is accurate and visible where required.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the schema type is relevant and every factual claim is visible and supported. This is a selected-field check, not complete Schema.org validation.

evidence.detail: 1 markup checks need review: This value was not matched in the supplied visible content. Confirm it is accurate and visible where required.

findings.title: Readable content
findings.detail: 952 words extracted from the available main content.
findings.recommendation: Answer the visitor’s actual question. There is no universal minimum word count; short product and contact pages can be appropriate.

evidence.detail: 952 words extracted from the available main content.

findings.title: Connected, useful pages
findings.detail: 55 internal links were observed in this page.
findings.recommendation: Link where it helps visitors. Site-wide crawl evidence is needed to identify orphan pages; no fixed link quota applies.

evidence.detail: 55 internal links were observed in this page.

findings.title: Declared content language
findings.recommendation: Declare the actual language of the page for accessibility. A country selection should not change the language of genuine content.

findings.title: Identifiable authorship
findings.detail: Authorship could not be confirmed from the extracted metadata.
findings.recommendation: For advice or editorial content, identify the responsible author and relevant experience. This may not apply to every page.

evidence.detail: Authorship could not be confirmed from the extracted metadata.

findings.title: Answer clarity review
findings.detail: Answer quality requires a contextual review; heading counts alone cannot establish it.
findings.recommendation: Use Content Studio to review whether this page directly answers its intended questions and supports factual claims.

evidence.detail: Answer quality requires a contextual review; heading counts alone cannot establish it.
